Definitions (OURS; bb_top_bt.py re-detects the setup from 15m OHLC as event_table.py:46-68 and computes fills itself): E1 sell-stop at green open, filled when the red bar trades below it; E2 red close below green open, fill next open; E3 red close below green low, fill next open. S1 = max(green, red high) + 2 ticks; S2 = red open + 2 ticks. Cushion k = 0.
